## EGM review (only for changes users see)

<!-- Pages, forms, install steps, layout. See https://buddhistai.github.io/knowledge-base/handbook/ux.html -->

- Design: <!-- docs/designs/<file>.md -->
- [ ] Small change: a text or bug fix I can describe in two sentences. No design needed.
- Review summary: <!-- reviewers that ran, open findings, accepted risks -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/build.py` and `python3 scripts/check.py` (or a maintainer will).
- [ ] New or changed workflow: the owner agreed, and is credited in `owner` / `contributors`.
- [ ] Linked workflow: summarized in our own words, not copied.
- [ ] New task: its ID is proposed for buddhist-benchmarks `tasks/index.json` too.
- [ ] I added my name to `contributors` on the pages I changed.
